verdict.rationale: Fly Machines are persistent, hardware-isolated VMs (not typical ephemeral serverless functions) that boot fast and run close to users globally, which architecturally supports long-lived connections like WebSockets, but no evidence explicitly documents WebSocket handling or real-time connection APIs. missing for 10: explicit WebSocket/real-time API documentation, hands-on example of persistent socket handling in a Fly app, confirmation of behavior under Fly's edge/global routing for stateful connections.
